summary: Design the 3 new-code pieces that let the node cold-start, advance, and serve reads on the log/projection/Job engine alone (no legacy coins.db / importer)

designs.blocker: BLOCKER 1 — block_index + nStatus population. After deleting the legacy accept_block.c / process_block_core.c / connect_tip.c / activate_best_chain.c connect path AND the legacy boot loader (app/services/src/block_index_loader.c) + block_index_db.c LevelDB writer, NOTHING populates the in-memory map_block_index / chain_active that EVERY stage reads via active_chain_at(&ms->chain_active, h), and nothing sets the BLOCK_HAVE_DATA / BLOCK_VALID_* nStatus bits those stages gate on. Worse: the EV_BLOCK_HEADER event-log feed itself is emitted ONLY from the legacy LevelDB write path (block_index_db.c:297 -> emit_block_header_event :203), so deleting the legacy engine also starves the very projection that is meant to replace it. The fix is NOT a localized read-rewire; it is a new single-engine block-index substrate that (a) self-feeds EV_BLOCK_HEADER, (b) rebuilds the in-memory map at boot from the projection, and (c) keeps pprev/nStatus/nChainWork live as the stages advance.
designs.approach:
Chosen: option (a) — KEEP the in-memory map_block_index / chain_active as the hot read substrate that all 8 stages already use, but make the event_log->block_index_projection the AUTHORITATIVE on-disk source that (1) feeds itself and (2) rebuilds the in-memory map at boot. Do NOT rewire the ~12 stage read sites to call block_index_projection_get_by_height directly.

Why (a) over (b) [rewire every stage read to the projection]:
1. The stages do not just read scalar nStatus by height — they chase POINTERS: bi->pprev->phashBlock (header_admit_stage.c:268, validate_headers_validator.c:88/95, tip_finalize reorg_depth_from :246-254) and read bi->nChainWork (tip_finalize_stage.c:433-446). The projection schema (block_index_projection.c create_schema :119-131) stores hash/height/n_status/n_file/n_data_pos/n_undo_pos/n_time/n_bits/n_version/n_tx + a header blob. It stores NEITHER pprev linkage NOR nChainWork NOR nChainTx. get_by_height (:548) returns a flattened struct disk_block_index with NO pointer graph. Rewiring would mean reconstructing the pprev walk and recomputing nChainWork on EVERY active_chain_at call across 12 sites and 4 distinct deref patterns — a far larger and more error-prone change than keeping the one place that already builds the graph (active_chain_set_tip in lib/validation/src/chainstate.c:279, which walks pprev to fill chain[]).
2. active_chain_set_tip ALSO drives the authority callback (chainstate.c sets g_chain_authority.set_tip) and the chain_active.chain[] array that active_chain_at indexes in O(1) (chainstate.c:266). That machinery is the tip cursor's RAM mirror and must survive regardless.
3. Option (a) is a 3-piece additive change with a clean ownership story: NEW header_admit emit + NEW boot rebuilder + NEW body_persist HAVE_DATA setter. Option (b) touches 12 read sites and still needs the pprev/work reconstruction, i.e. it is option (a)'s work PLUS the rewrite.

So the new single-engine substrate = three new pieces:
PIECE 1 (feed): header_admit_stage, when authoritative, becomes the SOLE emitter of EV_BLOCK_HEADER (today emitted by legacy block_index_db.c:297). It also inserts/links the in-memory block_index entry (map_block_index + pprev + BLOCK_VALID_TREE) — taking over what accept_block_header.c does today.
PIECE 2 (boot rebuild): a NEW loader load_block_index_from_projection() replaces block_index_loader.c's legacy readers. It block_index_projection_catch_up()'s the event log, then iterates the projection (block_index_projection_iterate :576) inserting every entry into map_block_index, links pprev via the hashPrev carried in the parsed header blob (disk_block_index.hashPrev, populated at block_index_projection.c:499), recomputes nChainWork via GetBlockProof + pprev (mirroring block_index_loader.c:639-671), and sets chain_active to the tip_finalize cursor height via csr/chain_set_active_tip.
PIECE 3 (HAVE_DATA): body_persist_stage, on a verified body, sets bi->nStatus |= BLOCK_HAVE_DATA in RAM AND re-emits EV_BLOCK_HEADER with the updated nStatus so the projection persists it (replacing disk_block_io.c:473 set_have_data_verified + the legacy write). utxo_apply/tip_finalize then see BLOCK_HAVE_DATA + BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS (script_validate_stage sets VALID_SCRIPTS) on the live in-memory entry exactly as today.

Net: the projection is the durable log-derived block_index; the in-memory map is a reb-buildable cache; the stages are unchanged readers. tip = tip_finalize cursor (unchanged).
primitives_verified: active_chain_at — lib/validation/src/chainstate.c:266: O(1) c->chain[height] index; returns NULL out of [0,c->height]. Confirmed the stages' sole height->block_index accessor.

active_chain_set_tip — lib/validation/src/chainstate.c:279: walks bi->pprev to fill chain[] down to genesis and fires g_chain_authority.set_tip. This is the ONLY builder of the chain[] array and must be retained.

struct block_index — lib/chain/include/chain/chain.h:79-120: carries phashBlock, pprev, pskip, nChainWork, nStatus, nHeight, hashFinalSaplingRoot. nStatus bits at chain.h:21-62 (BLOCK_HAVE_DATA=8, BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS=5, BLOCK_VALID_TREE=2, BLOCK_VALID_HEADER=1, BLOCK_VALID_MASK=7).

map_block_index / block_map API — lib/validation/include/validation/chainstate.h:67-88: block_map_insert, block_map_find, block_map_reserve, block_map_next iterator. chainstate_insert_block_index(:131) is the insert-or-find used by loaders.

block_index_projection_iterate — lib/storage/src/block_index_projection.c:576: streams ALL rows ORDER BY height ASC, hash ASC, decoding each blob to struct disk_block_index via blob_to_disk_block_index (:490). Confirmed it reconstructs hashPrev (:499), nHeight, nStatus, nFile, nDataPos, nUndoPos, nTime, nBits, nVersion, nTx, sapling root, solution.
block_index_projection_get_by_height — :548: CONFIRMED zero production readers (only test_block_index_projection.c:228/238). The diff tool (chain_controller.c:616) uses _get by hash, not by height.

block_index_projection_catch_up — :431: drains event_log from last_consumed_offset into the SQLite projection, idempotent (INSERT OR REPLACE), persists cursor in projection_meta. This is the boot drain primitive.

struct ev_block_header — lib/storage/include/storage/event_log_payloads.h:976: carries hash, hashPrev, height, nStatus, nFile, nDataPos, nUndoPos, nTime, nBits, nNonce, hashMerkleRoot, hashFinalSaplingRoot, nVersion, nTx, nSolutionSize. ev_block_header_serialize (:1010) + ev_block_header_parse confirmed round-trip.

EV_BLOCK_HEADER emit — lib/storage/src/block_index_db.c:203 emit_block_header_event, called ONLY at :297 inside block_tree_db_write_block_index_internal (the legacy LevelDB write). CONFIRMED this is the single feed of the projection — deleting it starves the projection.

set_have_data_verified — lib/storage/src/disk_block_io.c:436-475: reads the body back, hash-checks, then sets pindex->nStatus |= BLOCK_HAVE_DATA (:473). This is today's HAVE_DATA setter that body_persist must replace.
GetBlockProof — lib/chain/include/chain/pow.h:33: used by block_index_loader.c:642 to recompute nChainWork from pprev. Available for the projection-based rebuild.

header_admit_stage authoritative path — app/jobs/src/header_admit_stage.c:119 authoritative_admit currently only promotes nStatus to BLOCK_VALID_TREE on an EXISTING bi found via block_map_find (:130). It does NOT insert new entries — that gap is what PIECE 1 fills.

body_persist_stage — app/jobs/src/body_persist_stage.c:263 reads active_chain_at + requires bi->nStatus & BLOCK_HAVE_DATA (:264), already emits EV_BLOCK_BODY (:314) but NEVER sets BLOCK_HAVE_DATA — that gap is PIECE 3.

chain_set_active_tip — app/services/src/chain_tip.c:106: wraps active_chain_set_tip + authority sync + fsync barrier; used by all non-legacy tip setters (snapshot_apply, utxo_recovery). The boot rebuilder reuses this.

edits.change: PIECE 1 (feed + insert). (1) Extend authoritative_admit(ms, bi) [:119]: before the existing block_map_find/VALID_TREE promotion, when bi is NOT yet in the map (mapped==NULL), insert it: call chainstate_insert_block_index((struct chainstate*)ms, bi->phashBlock) to get/create the canonical entry, copy header scalars (nHeight,nBits,nTime,nVersion,hashMerkleRoot,hashFinalSaplingRoot,nNonce,nSolution/Size) from the admitted header, link pprev = block_map_find(map, &parent_hash) (parent_hash already computed in step_admit :266), compute nChainWork = pprev ? add(pprev->nChainWork, GetBlockProof(bi)) : GetBlockProof(bi), set nStatus = BLOCK_VALID_TREE. (2) Add a new static emit_block_header_event_from_bi(struct block_index *bi) that builds struct ev_block_header from bi (hash=phashBlock, hashPrev=pprev?phashBlock:zero, all scalars, nStatus) and event_log_append(event_log_singleton(), EV_BLOCK_HEADER, ...) — lifted verbatim from block_index_db.c:203-269, the to-be-deleted emitter. Call it at the end of step_admit [:285 area] when header_admit_get_mode()==AUTHORITATIVE, so the projection feed survives the legacy delete. Best-effort/counted, never fatal (mirror block_index_db.c semantics). NOTE: step_admit currently REQUIRES bi to already exist via active_chain_at (:263) — that dependency must move: in single-engine mode the admit inbox / header_sync delivers (height, hash, parent, header-scalars) and header_admit creates the entry, rather than reading one the legacy path created. The msg_headers.c accept_block_header path is the upstream producer that must hand header scalars to the header_admit inbox (struct header_admit_msg in services/header_admit_inbox.h needs the header fields, not just height+hash) — flag as a coupled change.

PIECE 2 (boot rebuild). Add bool load_block_index_from_projection(struct main_state *ms, const struct chain_params *params): (1) block_index_projection_catch_up(block_index_projection_singleton()) to drain the event log to the projection. (2) Allocate one block_index arena sized to block_index_projection_count(); iterate via block_index_projection_iterate with a callback that, per (hash32, disk_block_index dbi), does block_map_insert(&ms->map_block_index, &hash, &arena[i]) and copies dbi scalars (nHeight,nStatus,nFile,nDataPos,nUndoPos,nTime,nBits,nVersion,nTx,hashFinalSaplingRoot,nSolution) + stashes dbi.hashPrev for phase 2. (3) Phase 2: link pprev = block_map_find(map, &hashPrev) for each (identical to existing :290-306). (4) Phase 3: qsort by height, recompute nChainWork (GetBlockProof+pprev) and nChainTx and block_index_build_skip — REUSE the existing post-load block in this file at :639-671 verbatim. (5) Set the tip: read tip_finalize_stage_cursor()/last_height, find that block_index, call chain_set_active_tip(ms, tip, TIP_FROM_RESTORE, "loader_from_projection") (or csr_commit_tip as the genesis path does at :595-604). DELETE load_block_index (LevelDB), load_block_index_sqlite, load_block_index_flat / save_block_index_flat / save_block_index_recent once callers are switched. The genesis-bootstrap branch (:575-619) is RETAINED but moved into the new function for the empty-projection case.

PIECE 3 (HAVE_DATA). In step_persist, after the body is read+hash-checked+merkle-verified and emit_block_body_event runs (:314), BEFORE block_free: set bi->nStatus |= BLOCK_HAVE_DATA (bi already in hand at :263), set bi->nFile/nDataPos from the reader's disk position if the single-engine writer records it, and re-emit EV_BLOCK_HEADER for bi with the now-updated nStatus (reuse the header_admit emitter, exposed via a small shared helper or duplicated) so the projection persists BLOCK_HAVE_DATA durably. This replaces disk_block_io.c:473 set_have_data_verified. Guard on body_persist authoritative mode if a mode exists; otherwise gate on tip_finalize/utxo author == STAGE. The existing precondition reads (:264) then see HAVE_DATA on the live in-memory entry, and utxo_apply (:225) / tip_finalize preconditions_ok (:261) consume it unchanged.

NO logic change required — active_chain_set_tip (:279) and active_chain_at (:266) are RETAINED as the in-memory cursor mirror. Only confirm the genesis/empty-map init no longer assumes a legacy loader populated the map first. The block_map + active_chain structs and APIs stay.

DELETE the LevelDB write path block_tree_db_write_block_index[_sync] (:271-310) and its emit_block_header_event (:203) — its EV_BLOCK_HEADER emit responsibility moves to header_admit (PIECE 1) and body_persist (PIECE 3). This is the deletion that would otherwise silently starve the projection; the spec moves the emit FIRST, then deletes.

risks: FEED-BEFORE-DELETE ordering is load-bearing: EV_BLOCK_HEADER is today emitted ONLY at block_index_db.c:297. If the legacy writer is deleted before PIECE 1's header_admit emitter lands, the block_index_projection stops being fed and the boot rebuilder (PIECE 2) loads a stale/empty map -> total halt. Must land PIECE 1 emit, verify projection still grows, THEN delete block_index_db.c writer in the same or later commit.

nChainWork/nChainTx are NOT in the projection schema; they are RECOMPUTED at boot from GetBlockProof+pprev (PIECE 2 phase 3). If a fork has two same-height entries, block_index_projection_get_by_height's ORDER BY hash ASC LIMIT 1 is arbitrary — but PIECE 2 uses _iterate (all rows) + hashPrev linking, so forks are preserved. Confirm the recompute matches what tip_finalize compares (new_tip->nChainWork > old_tip->nChainWork at :433) or a converged tip can falsely read precondition_failed.

header_admit step_admit currently DEPENDS on active_chain_at returning an entry the legacy path created (:263). In single-engine mode the producer relationship inverts: header_admit must CREATE entries from header scalars delivered by msg_headers/accept_block_header via the header_admit inbox. struct header_admit_msg (services/header_admit_inbox.h) only carries height+hash+peer today — it must carry the full header scalars, or header_admit cannot populate nBits/nTime/merkle/etc. This is a coupled producer-side change not yet scoped here.

BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS is set by script_validate_stage on the in-memory bi; tip_finalize preconditions_ok (:262) reads it. The rebuild at boot must re-derive VALID_SCRIPTS from the projection's persisted nStatus (which body_persist/script_validate must have emitted) — otherwise post-restart the tip cannot finalize until re-validation. Confirm script_validate_stage also emits an nStatus-updating EV_BLOCK_HEADER (a 4th emit site) or VALID_SCRIPTS is lost across restart.

Memory: PIECE 2 allocates a 3.1M-entry block_index arena (~ same as today's loader). The projection iterate + insert must hit the existing ~30-60s boot budget; block_index_projection is a separate sqlite file with its own WAL, so the iterate is a single ORDER BY height scan — acceptable but must be benched against the legacy flat-file mmap load (block_index_loader.c:166 loads in a few seconds).

fsync/durability ordering (MEMORY: at-tip kill-9 invariant): the projection commit must land before the tip cursor advances, mirroring the coins.db-before-block_index rule. block_index_projection_catch_up commits in 1000-event batches; ensure the tip_finalize cursor never gets ahead of the projection's last_consumed_offset on a crash.
designs.test: "Live single-engine cold-start proof on a copy of the datadir (never the live one): (1) Build with PIECE 1+2+3 and the legacy block_index_db writer deleted. (2) Boot on an at-tip import-anchored datadir copy. Assert via MCP: zcl_state subsystem=block_index shows entry_count == zcl_getblockcount+1 and last_consumed_offset > 0 (projection fed + rebuilt). (3) zcl_status: height advances past the import anchor (stages connect new blocks with the in-memory map the rebuilder built). (4) zcl_state subsystem=block_index_projection vs the in-memory map: block_index_projection_commitment matches the legacy block_index_diff baseline (already wired as zcl_block_index_diff). (5) Restart the node (kill + reboot) and assert the tip is preserved and BLOCK_HAVE_DATA/VALID_SCRIPTS survive (no full re-validation storm) — proves PIECE 3's nStatus re-emit persisted. (6) Unit: extend test_block_index_projection.c to cover _iterate-based full-map reconstruction + pprev linking via hashPrev, and add a header_admit authoritative-emit test asserting EV_BLOCK_HEADER lands in the event log when no legacy writer runs. Gate: make lint clean + test_parallel green (read the 'N passed, M failed' line)."

designs.blocker: BLOCKER 2 — cold-start boot_rebuild_from_log(). Today the in-memory chain (g_state.map_block_index + active_chain tip + coins view) is rebuilt EXCLUSIVELY from legacy sources: load_block_index_flat / load_block_index_sqlite / LevelDB (config/src/boot.c:1804-1886), the zclassicd-LDB sibling auto-import (boot.c:1892-2104, reads $HOME/.zclassic/blocks/index), and utxo_recovery_import_ldb (boot.c:2292-2309). The event_log + projections exist but are pure SHADOW: boot_start_phase4_storage_shadow (config/src/boot_services.c:1104-1237) opens the event_log, runs block_index_projection_catch_up and utxo_projection_catch_up into their own SQLite tables, but NOTHING folds those back into g_state.map_block_index or the active tip. block_index_projection_catch_up writes ONLY its own block_index SQLite table (lib/storage/src/block_index_projection.c:443-487). So with the legacy path deleted, the node has an empty in-mem map and no tip — it cannot serve reads or advance. boot_rebuild_from_log() is the missing single-engine equivalent of the three legacy loaders.
designs.approach: Add one new function boot_rebuild_from_log(struct app_context *ctx, const struct chain_params *params) in config/src/boot.c that replaces ALL THREE legacy loaders (the flat/sqlite/LevelDB load at boot.c:1799-1886, the zclassicd-LDB sibling import at boot.c:1892-2104, and utxo_recovery_import_ldb at boot.c:2292-2309). It does NOT touch any $HOME/.zclassic path. Sequence inside the function: (1) Open event_log + projections EARLY (move the open/catch_up out of boot_services.c:1104 phase4-shadow into boot_rebuild_from_log so they are authoritative and available during app_init's index-build window, before tip restore). Reuse event_log_open + event_log_set_singleton + block_index_projection_open/set_singleton + block_index_projection_catch_up + utxo_projection_open/set_event_log + utxo_projection_catch_up exactly as boot_services.c already does. (2) FOLD the block_index_projection into g_state.map_block_index: call block_index_projection_iterate (canonical height-ASC, hash-ASC order, lib/storage/src/block_index_projection.c) with a callback that, per disk_block_index row, calls chainstate_insert_block_index(&g_state, &hash) (already used by boot_insert_block_index_cb at boot.c:357-362) and copies fields using the EXACT mapping from block_tree_db_load_block_index_guts (block_index_db.c:401-428): pprev (resolved via a second insert of dbi.hashPrev), nHeight, nFile, nDataPos, nUndoPos, nVersion, hashMerkleRoot, hashFinalSaplingRoot, nTime, nBits, nNonce, nStatus, nCachedBranchId, nTx, sprout/sapling values; set nSolution=NULL/0. OMIT the file-0 +1703 nDataPos fixup (that is a zclassicd-LDB-position quirk; the projection's nDataPos already comes from this node's own body_persist_stage, so it is already correct). After the fold, fix phashBlock pointers and propagate nChainWork/nChainTx using the EXISTING forward-pass code already inline at boot.c:1965-2029 (factor it or inline it). (3) SEED THE TIP from the durable cursor: the UTXO authority is utxo_projection (catch_up already replayed it to the event-log head); the tip is the tip_finalize cursor in progress.kv. Read finalized_height = stage_cursor_persisted(progress_store_db(), "tip_finalize", "boot_rebuild") - 1, read the tip hash from the tip_finalize_log row at that height, locate that block_index in the just-rebuilt map, call tip_finalize_stage_set_authoritative_tip(height, hash) (seeds g_last_advance_height which is what active_chain reads via the registered authority, tip_finalize_stage.c:606-610) AND boot_promote_tip_via_csr(tip, "rebuild_from_log", false) to publish active_chain/coins_tip via the CSR (boot.c:728-766). For a COLD (empty) datadir: event_log_open creates an empty log, both catch_ups return offset 0, the fold inserts nothing, the tip cursor is absent so no tip is set — the node sits at genesis and the existing fast_sync path (lib/net/src/fast_sync.c) must seed it. Today fast_sync's receiver (app/services/src/snapshot_apply.c:53-60) writes the SHA3 UTXO snapshot DIRECTLY into the legacy node.db `utxos` table via SQL and sets the tip through chain_evidence_controller_promote_tip — it never seeds the event_log/projection. So one NEW projection-seed primitive is required (modeled on utxo_projection_seed_from_legacy, utxo_projection.c:403-499): utxo_projection_seed_from_snapshot(p, staging_db) that bulk-INSERTs the verified snapshot rows into the projection's `utxo` table and stamps last_consumed_offset = event_log_size(log) + anchor_seeded=1, plus a block_index header seed for the anchor block so the fold finds the anchor tip. snapshot_apply.c is then rewired to call that instead of (or in addition to, during cutover) the `INSERT ... FROM staging` into node.db, and to stamp the tip_finalize cursor to the snapshot anchor height via stage_set_cursor.

edits.change: ADD static bool boot_rebuild_from_log(struct app_context *ctx, const struct chain_params *params). Body: (1) char event_path/utxo_path/bip_path = "%s/event_log.dat | utxo_projection.db | block_index_projection.db", ctx->datadir; event_log_t *log = event_log_open(event_path); if(!log) return false; event_log_set_singleton(log). (2) block_index_projection_t *bip = block_index_projection_open(bip_path, log); block_index_projection_set_singleton(bip); block_index_projection_catch_up(bip). (3) utxo_projection_set_event_log(log); utxo_projection_t *up = utxo_projection_open(utxo_path, log); utxo_projection_catch_up(up). (4) FOLD: block_index_projection_iterate(bip, fold_cb, &g_state) where fold_cb does pindex=chainstate_insert_block_index(ms,&hash); pprev=chainstate_insert_block_index(ms,&idx->hashPrev); then copy nHeight/nFile/nDataPos/nUndoPos/nVersion/hashMerkleRoot/hashFinalSaplingRoot/nTime/nBits/nNonce/nStatus/nCachedBranchId/nTx/sprout+sapling per block_index_db.c:401-428 WITHOUT the +1703 fixup, nSolution=NULL/0. (5) phashBlock fixup loop + nChainWork/nChainTx forward pass (lift from boot.c:1965-2029). (6) sqlite3 *pk=progress_store_db(); uint64_t c=stage_cursor_persisted(pk,"tip_finalize","boot_rebuild"); if(c>0){int h=(int)c-1; read tip_hash from tip_finalize_log at h (reuse a small SELECT or expose finalized_tip_row_at); struct block_index *tip=block_map_find(&g_state.map_block_index,&tiphash); if(tip){ tip_finalize_stage_set_authoritative_tip(h,tiphash.data); boot_promote_tip_via_csr(tip,"rebuild_from_log",false);}} return true. Cold datadir: c==0 -> no tip set, return true (genesis).

In app_init: REPLACE the legacy block-index load block (lines ~1799-1886 flat/sqlite/LevelDB), the zclassicd-LDB sibling auto-import block (~1892-2104), and the utxo_recovery_import_ldb call (~2292-2309) with a single guarded call: if(!boot_rebuild_from_log(ctx, params)) return false;. designs.blocker: BLOCKER 3 — read-serving off the projection after coins_view_sqlite (lib/storage/src/coins_view_sqlite.c) is deleted. Reads currently resolve from the legacy `utxos` table in node.db via two distinct paths that both must move to utxo_projection's `utxo` table.
designs.approach:
There are exactly TWO legacy read surfaces to rewire, plus a no-op cleanup. I verified the surfaces by reading the code rather than the plan's claim of "balance/listunspent coins_tip reads":

(A) PER-TXID coins reads — every consumer that calls coins_view_cache_get_coins(ctx->coins_tip, ...) (wallet balance/listunspent in wallet_controller.c:205/462, transaction_controller.c:112, chain_inspect_controller.c:281, wallet_diagnostic_*.c, repair_controller_utxo.c, transaction_controller_sign.c:313). These all flow through ONE seam: the cache's backing coins_view (coins_view_cache.base, set by coins_view_cache_init at coins_view.c:145). On a cache miss, coins_view_cache_get_coins (coins_view.c:173) dispatches to the backing vtable. So rewiring the single backing rewires every per-txid read at once — no per-call-site edits needed. The byte-compatible replacement already exists: coins_view_projection (lib/storage/src/coins_view_projection.c), whose get_coins delegates to utxo_projection_get_coins (utxo_projection.c:543). I confirmed utxo_projection_get_coins mirrors coins_view_sqlite_get_coins byte-for-byte: same two-pass max-vout/fill, version hardcoded to 1, same height/is_coinbase/script handling.

(B) AGGREGATE/whole-table reads that hit ctx->node_db->db (the `utxos` table) directly, bypassing coins_tip: gettxoutsetinfo (blockchain_controller_chain.c:355-357, COUNT/SUM over utxos) and the SHA3 commitment readers getutxocommitment (:410), dataintegrity (:536) via utxo_commitment_sha3_compute(ctx->node_db->db,...). Replacements exist and are byte-compatible: utxo_projection_count (utxo_projection.c:603) and utxo_projection_commitment (utxo_projection.c:627). I diffed utxo_projection_commitment against utxo_commitment_sha3_compute_table (utxo_commitment.c:227): identical field serialization (txid32||vout_le4||value_le8||script_len_le4||script||height_le4||is_coinbase1) and identical ORDER BY txid,vout. The legacy version's ≤1024B one-buffer packing is an optimization its own comment states is byte-identical, so commitments match when the UTXO sets match.

(C) CLEANUP — the coins_view_cache_flush(ctx->coins_tip) calls that precede each aggregate read (chain:344, :405, :532, :584) exist to push the legacy write-cache into the `utxos` table before a raw read. In the single-engine world coins_tip is read-only (the stage authors via events), so these flushes are dead and the projection view's batch_write LOG_FAILs by design (coins_view_projection.c:48). They must be removed.

Chosen wiring approach: point g_coins_tip's backing at coins_view_projection directly at boot, rather than at the coins_view_stage_backing composite (lib/storage/src/coins_view_stage_backing.c). Rationale: the composite routes reads→projection but writes/best→legacy view; once coins_view_sqlite is deleted there is no legacy view to route to, so the composite collapses to "reads→projection, writes→LOG_FAIL, best→null" which is exactly coins_view_projection. Using coins_view_projection directly is the simpler single-engine shape (less-is-more doctrine). best_block returning null is safe: I confirmed all read RPCs take the tip from active_chain_tip(&ctx->main_state->chain_active) (chain:347), never from coins_tip best-block.

NOT in scope (verified): getblock body reads stay on disk_block_io — rpc_getblock (blockchain_controller_blocks.c:216) reads only block_map_find header data; block bodies are written by body_persist_stage.c (includes storage/disk_block_io.h) and read from disk files, never from the coins table. There is no `gettxout` RPC handler registered (blockchain_controller.c only registers gettxoutsetinfo); `gettxout` appears only as an outbound client call in repair_controller_utxo.c:20, so no per-UTXO read handler needs rewiring.
primitives_verified: utxo_projection_get_global() — lib/storage/src/utxo_projection.c:110, returns the process-global utxo_projection_t* published by utxo_projection_open:215; non-NULL at rewire time because boot_start_phase4_storage_shadow (boot_services.c:2129, opens projection at :1097) runs before rpc_blockchain_set_coins_db (boot_services.c:2588)

coins_view_projection_init() — lib/storage/src/coins_view_projection.c:76, binds a struct coins_view_projection to a utxo_projection_t and publishes the read-only vtable (get_coins→utxo_projection_get_coins, batch_write→LOG_FAIL, get_best_block→null/false)
utxo_projection_get_coins() — lib/storage/src/utxo_projection.c:543, byte-compatible with coins_view_sqlite_get_coins (verified field-by-field against coins_view_sqlite.c:564)

plan.chicken_egg_resolution:
YES there is a real chicken-and-egg, and the three designs UNDER-SCOPE it. Verified by reading code:

THE CYCLE: All 8 stages are pure CONSUMERS of the in-memory block_index. header_admit/step_admit (header_admit_stage.c:263-264), body_persist (body_persist_stage.c:263-267), script_validate (script_validate_stage.c:329-330), utxo_apply (utxo_apply_stage.c:224-225), validate_headers (validate_headers_validator.c:88-96 chases bi->pprev->phashBlock), and tip_finalize (preconditions_ok :261-262) ALL call active_chain_at(&ms->chain_active, h) and return JOB_IDLE/BLOCKED if bi==NULL, or gate on bi->nStatus bits. NONE of them CREATE an entry or set BLOCK_HAVE_DATA / BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS. The actual PRODUCER of in-memory entries (with header scalars + pprev + nChainWork) is add_to_block_index() at process_block_core.c:213 — a DELETE TARGET — invoked via accept_block_header() (accept_block_header.c:462) from the P2P ingest msg_headers.c:364 / header_probe.c:182. And the ONLY setter of BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS on the in-mem bi is connect_tip.c:158/642 — also a DELETE TARGET. BLOCK_HAVE_DATA is set only in connect_tip.c:156/180, disk_block_io.c:473 (set_have_data_verified), block_index_loader.c:581 (genesis), and chain_restore_disk_repair.c:450. So deleting the legacy connect path removes BOTH the producer of the map AND the setters of the very nStatus bits the stages gate on — the stages would spin JOB_IDLE forever on an empty/stale map.

The projection FEED is itself part of the cycle: EV_BLOCK_HEADER is emitted at exactly ONE site — block_index_db.c:261 via emit_block_header_event(:203) called at :297 inside the legacy LevelDB write. Deleting the legacy engine starves block_index_projection, so PIECE 2's boot rebuilder reads an empty/stale projection.

RESOLUTION (a strict producer/consumer split that breaks the cycle, layered onto the designs):
1. SEED the map at boot from the projection, NOT from replayed stage output. boot_rebuild_from_log (BLOCKER 2) folds block_index_projection -> map_block_index BEFORE any stage runs (app_init at boot.c, well before stages init at service start, boot_services.c:2129/3345). On a WARM datadir the projection already holds the historical chain, so the map is fully populated at boot with no stage involvement — no cycle.
2. MOVE the producer, do not delete it. Relocate add_to_block_index()'s body into the single-engine header-ingest path so accept_block_header (kept; it is the P2P producer, NOT in the connect-path delete set) still creates entries. The designs' "header_admit inserts new entries" is insufficient because header_admit/step_admit reads active_chain_at and never sees a producer-less entry; the entry must be created upstream at header arrival (accept_block_header -> add_to_block_index), exactly as today, BEFORE header_admit's cursor reaches it. Keep add_to_block_index by relocating it out of process_block_core.c (e.g. into accept_block_header.c) so deleting the connect path doesn't take the producer with it.
3. ADD the missing nStatus setters as new stage side-effects (the 4th/5th pieces the designs omit): body_persist sets bi->nStatus |= BLOCK_HAVE_DATA (PIECE 3, in the designs) AND script_validate sets bi->nStatus |= BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS (NOT in the designs — must add), each followed by a re-emit of EV_BLOCK_HEADER carrying the updated nStatus so the projection persists it. Without the script_validate setter, tip_finalize.preconditions_ok (:262) NEVER passes and the tip cannot advance.
4. COLD start (empty datadir) has no projection to fold, so the cycle is broken by fast_sync SEEDING the projection (utxo_projection_seed_from_snapshot + an anchor EV_BLOCK_HEADER + tip_finalize cursor stamp). The anchor entry then exists in the map after the next boot's fold, giving the stages a non-empty base to extend.

Net: map_block_index is seeded from a DURABLE source (projection at boot, P2P accept_block_header at runtime) that is INDEPENDENT of stage execution; stages only EXTEND nStatus and EMIT events; the projection is fed by accept_block_header(relocated add_to_block_index emit) + body_persist + script_validate, never by the legacy writer. The cycle is cut because production (entry+pprev) precedes consumption (stage cursor) at every height.
missing_primitives: utxo_projection_setinfo(p, &num_txs, &num_txouts, &total_amount) — DOES NOT EXIST (verified: zero matches in tree). BLOCKER 3 needs it for gettxoutsetinfo. Must run SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT txid), COUNT(*), COALESCE(SUM(value),0) FROM utxo. Add to lib/storage/src/utxo_projection.c + header next to utxo_projection_count (:603).

utxo_projection_seed_from_snapshot(p, staging_db) — DOES NOT EXIST (verified: zero matches). BLOCKER 2 cold-start fast-sync needs it. Model byte-for-byte on utxo_projection_seed_from_legacy (utxo_projection.c:403-499) but SELECT FROM SNAPSYNC_STAGING_TABLE ('snapshot_staging_utxos', snapshot_sync_internal.h:40) instead of utxos. Add to utxo_projection.c + header.

load_block_index_from_projection() / boot_rebuild_from_log() — DOES NOT EXIST. BLOCKER 1 PIECE 2 / BLOCKER 2 core. Must be written: catch_up + block_index_projection_iterate fold into map_block_index + pprev link + nChainWork/nChainTx forward pass (reuse block_index_loader.c:639-671) + tip seed from tip_finalize cursor.

RELOCATED add_to_block_index() — EXISTS at process_block_core.c:213 but is a DELETE TARGET. The single-engine producer that creates in-mem entries (header scalars + pprev + nChainWork + block_map_insert) MUST survive the delete by being relocated (e.g. into accept_block_header.c), or accept_block_header.c:462 breaks and no in-mem entry is ever created at runtime. The designs treat this as a 'coupled change to flag' but it is a hard required primitive, not optional.

script_validate nStatus setter + EV_BLOCK_HEADER re-emit — DOES NOT EXIST as a stage side-effect. BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS is set ONLY in connect_tip.c:158/642 (delete target). script_validate_stage.c:375 writes only its own script_validate_log; it never sets bi->nStatus |= BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS. tip_finalize.preconditions_ok:262 HARD-GATES on it. A 4th nStatus-emit site (script_validate) is required and is NOT in any of the three designs' edits (only mentioned in a BLOCKER-1 risk).

header_admit_inbox header-scalar carry — struct header_admit_msg today carries only height+hash+peer (per BLOCKER 1 risk). If header_admit is to create entries it needs full header scalars. RESOLVED by keeping accept_block_header as the producer instead, but if the designs' 'header_admit inserts' approach is taken literally, this struct extension is a missing primitive.

plan.end_to_end_proof:
SINGLE END-TO-END PROOF (run on a COPY of the datadir, never the live one; ~/.zclassic renamed away to prove no legacy sibling read):

PHASE A — COLD START (proves the empty->seeded path): (1) Build with steps 1-10 applied (legacy engine deleted). (2) Wipe the COPY datadir, run zclassic23 -nobgvalidation with fast_sync to the SHA3 anchor. (3) Assert: strace -e trace=open,openat shows ZERO accesses to $HOME/.zclassic (legacy path gone); zcl_state subsystem=block_index_projection shows entry_count >= 1 (anchor header seeded by step 7) and last_consumed_offset > 0; zcl_utxocommitment returns the snapshot's SHA3 (proves utxo_projection_seed_from_snapshot landed in the projection, step 1+7).

PHASE B — ADVANCE (proves the cycle is cut and stages extend): (4) Let the node connect blocks past the anchor from P2P. Assert zcl_status height climbs above offered_height. This proves: accept_block_header(relocated add_to_block_index, step 2) creates in-mem entries -> header_admit emits EV_BLOCK_HEADER (step 3) -> body_persist sets BLOCK_HAVE_DATA + re-emits (step 4) -> script_validate sets BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS + re-emits (step 5) -> tip_finalize.preconditions_ok (:262) PASSES and advances the cursor. If step 5 were omitted, height would freeze at the anchor (precondition_failed) — so a climbing height is the positive proof of the 4th-piece fix.

PHASE C — WARM RESTART (proves boot_rebuild_from_log reconstructs from the log alone): (5) kill -9 then reboot the node with ~/.zclassic STILL renamed away. (6) Assert: zcl_status height == pre-restart height (within the known WAL kill-rewind 1-6 blocks) and zcl_chain_tip hash matches — boot_rebuild_from_log (step 6) folded block_index_projection -> map_block_index, recomputed nChainWork, and seeded the tip from the tip_finalize cursor purely from event_log.dat + block_index_projection.db + utxo_projection.db + progress.kv. (7) Assert NO re-validation storm: zcl_validationstatus does not restart from genesis — proves BLOCK_HAVE_DATA + BLOCK_VALID_SCRIPTS persisted via the step-4/step-5 nStatus re-emits and were restored by the fold.

PHASE D — CORRECT READ ON THE PROJECTION ALONE (the headline assertion): (8) zcl_rpc(method=gettxoutsetinfo): assert txouts == utxo_projection_count, total_amount and transactions match the pre-delete legacy baseline captured before the flip, and bestblock == active_chain_tip hash at the current height. This exercises utxo_projection_setinfo (step 1) through the rewired rpc_gettxoutsetinfo (step 9) with coins_tip backed by coins_view_projection (step 8) — NO node.db utxos table involved. (9) zcl_utxo_projection_diff == 0 and zcl_block_index_diff == 0 at tip (parity gates). (10) zcl_getblock for a historical hash still returns body data (proves block bodies stayed on disk_block_io, untouched by the coins-read flip).

GATE: PHASES A-D all green on the COPY + make lint clean + test_parallel 'N passed, 0 failed' (read the line, not the pipe exit). Only then is the single-engine change coherent: cold-start populates the map before stages read it (A+the boot fold), the bootstrap cycle is cut (B: production via accept_block_header precedes consumption at every height; nStatus bits set by the stages themselves, not the deleted connect path), all claimed primitives either verified-present or added in step 1-2-6-7, and gettxoutsetinfo serves correctly off the projection alone (D).
